name: Publisher feeds

rate_limit.source: No published limits; one request per second per host, and each feed is reused from cache for 15 minutes.

license_note: Publishers' own RSS feeds, read for one person: headline, source, date and link only, credited to the publisher (中央社 asks for 中央通訊社; RFA for its credit line). Feeds whose publishers forbid AI or automated use (BBC, The Guardian, Al Jazeera, DW, NYT 中文网) are not included. Feed checks: 27 Sep 2026.
